_comment: Intentionally empty. This file is NOT read by Claude Code at user scope.
Measured 2026-07-26/27 on Claude Code 2.1.220 by controlled A/B (same hook,
same absolute command, only the file differing, reproduced on two different
hook events): a hook here fires zero times, the same hook in settings.json
fires every time. settings.local.json is a PROJECT-scope filename
Everything that used to live here has moved to where it is actually read:
`mcpServers` block in settings.json is NOT read either, so moving them
alongside the hooks would have left them just as dead.
The file itself is kept (rather than deleted) because bootstrap, the emdash
inheritance check and the deploy fixtures all reference it as a path; an
empty stub keeps those honest without a rename cascade.
